test_policy.notes: CUNY-wide: test optional for undergraduate admission; first-year applicants may choose whether to submit SAT or ACT scores. College Navigator quotes the policy as in force through the spring 2027 semester; the CUNY page gives no end date, so fall 2027 entry is not separately confirmed. Medgar Evers applies this policy (College Navigator note).

requirements.notes: Apply with the CUNY Application (one application, up to 6 CUNY colleges); freshman fee $65, non-refundable (CUNY-wide). Medgar Evers freshman requirements: official high school transcript (or GED/TASC) sent to CUNY, and a high school GPA of 65 or better (GED 2250 or TASC 2500). College Navigator lists GPA and school record as required, essay and recommendations as not considered. Medgar Evers is a mixed associate/bachelor's college with 20+ majors.

deadlines.label: International applicant deadline - application (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Medgar Evers and CUNY both list the international freshman/transfer application deadline as December 1 and supporting documents by December 15, with rolling decisions January to July. The pages give no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. U.S.-educated freshmen use a February 1 priority date instead.

deadlines.label: International applicant deadline - supporting documents (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Supporting-document date for international applicants (Medgar Evers international page, same as CUNY-wide).

english_policy.waiver_notes: CUNY-wide: applicants on a temporary (F-1) visa who were educated in a non-English-speaking environment must submit official TOEFL, IELTS (Academic), PTE (Academic) or Duolingo scores; minimums are set by each college (CUNY comparison chart). Scores must be sent by the testing agency (CUNY code 2950); copies uploaded to the application are unofficial. No waiver rules are published and no conditional-admission or ESL pathway is described on the pages checked.

english.notes: CUNY comparison chart (internet-based TOEFL), Medgar Evers row. No score on the new 1-6 scale is given.

aid.notes: International (F-1/J-1) students pay the NYS non-resident rate ($620 per credit in 2026-27, CUNY-wide). No merit scholarship for international first-year students was found on the pages checked, so no aid policy is shown.

sat.note: No SAT code is printed on the CUNY or college pages checked; pick the college by name in the College Board search.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the CUNY or college pages checked; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: CUNY-wide university code 2950 (CUNY application page: list this code when registering for exams). Medgar Evers does not publish a separate code.

ielts.note: No IELTS institution code is listed; send results to CUNY through the IELTS system.

duolingo.note: No Duolingo institution code is listed.

pte.note: No PTE institution code is listed.

tier_notes.general: Our estimate: Brooklyn senior college in the CUNY system (mixed associate/bachelor's) with 20+ majors in business, health, education and social services; no nationally ranked programs found, so general and subject tiers are D.
